# DetailerFit — Search Impression Expansion Plan

## Objective

Maximize Google Search impressions by expanding query and page coverage. This plan is intentionally focused on search visibility rather than CTR or affiliate conversion.

## Implementation rules

- Preserve the current DetailerFit design, structure, SEO, existing content, and affiliate links.
- Do not delete or materially rewrite existing ranking pages unless required for internal-linking or canonical cleanup.
- Build each new page as a genuinely useful standalone article; do not create thin or templated doorway pages.
- Use the listed SEO Title, H1, Primary Keyword, Secondary Keywords, content angle, H2 outline, internal links, and cannibalization guard as the implementation brief.
- Add contextual internal links from at least 2 relevant existing pages to each new page where natural.
- Link each new page back to 2–3 relevant established hubs/pages.
- Add published pages to sitemap.xml.
- Use HTTPS canonical URLs.
- Keep the existing dark + teal DetailerFit visual system.
- Publish by priority: P1 first, then P2, then P3.

## Current GSC context

- Current snapshot: 55 impressions, 0 clicks, settled through 2026-09-14.
- Relevant queries are already appearing, including broad software terms and Urable pricing intent.
- Goal of this plan: increase the number of distinct relevant queries and pages eligible to appear in Google Search.

## 30-page production map

### 1. Best Auto Detailing Invoicing Software in 2026

- **Priority:** P1 (Wave 1)
- **Cluster:** Workflow
- **Page type:** Buying guide
- **URL:** `https://getdetailerfit.com/best-auto-detailing-invoicing-software`
- **SEO Title:** Best Auto Detailing Invoicing Software (2026): 7 Tools Compared
- **H1:** Best Auto Detailing Invoicing Software in 2026
- **Primary Keyword:** auto detailing invoicing software
- **Secondary Keywords:** car detailing invoice software; mobile detailing invoice app; invoicing software for detailers; detailing estimate and invoice software; auto detailing billing software
- **Search Intent:** Commercial investigation
- **Why this expands impressions:** Creates a new feature-specific SERP footprint around invoices/billing instead of competing only on broad 'detailing software'.
- **Content angle:** Compare invoice creation, deposits, card payments, recurring billing, QuickBooks sync, mobile usability and usable-plan cost.
- **Required H2 outline:** What detailers need from invoicing software | Comparison table | Best overall | Best low-cost | Best automotive-specific | Payments & fees | Accounting integrations | Mobile workflow | FAQ
- **Internal links / hubs:** https://getdetailerfit.com/best-auto-detailing-software-2026; https://getdetailerfit.com/best-crm-solo-mobile-detailers; https://getdetailerfit.com/software-cost-calculator
- **Cannibalization guard:** Do not make this another general CRM roundup; keep the page centered on invoice/billing workflow.
- **Planning basis:** GSC query family expansion + current site coverage review

## Recommended execution order

1. Complete all P1 pages first.
2. Verify each published URL is internally linked, included in sitemap.xml, canonicalized to HTTPS, and crawlable.
3. Review early GSC query impressions before publishing P2, then continue unless a clear cannibalization issue appears.
4. Publish P2 pages.
5. Publish P3 pages to fill narrower query gaps.

## Completion report required after implementation

After each wave, report:
- New pages created
- Existing pages modified
- Internal links added
- sitemap.xml changes
- Canonical changes, if any
- Any skipped page and the exact reason
